## Observed behavior

Describe the problem. Distinguish a documentation error, interface state, server report and physical observation.

## Context

- Page, source version or commit:
- Relevant module and runtime, if applicable:
- Time and time zone:
- Synthetic test, replayed record or real device:

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest offline-safe procedure and expected and actual outcomes. If no safe reproduction exists, state that it is unconfirmed.

## Evidence

Attach only short, de-identified evidence. Distinguish nominal accounted volume from measured volume.

Do not include passwords, tokens, private configuration, operational addresses, raw research records or unapproved photographs. Do not disclose sensitive security details in a public issue.
